exposure: Introduction of a dedicated breech clinic
cohort: Women with term (from 37 weeks), singleton fetus and breech presentation at delivery
finding: The introduction of a dedicated breech clinic led to an increase in vaginal deliveries for breech babies without adversely affecting neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: After the introduction of the breech clinic, there was a significant increase in planned vaginal delivery from 7.4% to 53.0% and the effective vaginal breech delivery rate significantly increased from 4.3% to 43.5%.
